stem: How does the author’s use of language in paragraph 12 contribute to the tone of the article?

options.label: A
options.text: It provides an enthusiastic tone to support the idea that geology is important to human life.

options.label: B
options.text: It presents an informal tone that helps the reader better understand how fall lines develop.

options.label: C
options.text: It provides a hopeful tone that people in the future will be more aware of the need to protect nature.

options.label: D
options.text: It presents a casual tone to make the complex subject of geology more interesting and relatable.
